Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cnt number := 0;
 list_counter number := 1 ;
 v_list_name varchar2(50) ;
 in_string varchar2(100) ;
begin
 go_block('LIST_BLOCK') ;
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :list_block.select_flag = 'Y' then
 cnt := cnt + 1 ;
 end if ;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit ;
 else
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 if cnt = 0 then
 if :global.load_option = 'DONATION_TYPE' then
 :in_string_don := null;
 :control_block.s_donation_type := null ;
 :control_block.s_donation_type_desc := null ;
 set_item_property('S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 elsif :global.load_option = 'PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 :in_string_proc := null;
 :control_block.proc_code := null ;
 :control_block.s_proc_desc := null ;
 set_item_property('S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 end if ;
 elsif cnt = 1 then
 if :global.load_option = 'DONATION_TYPE' then
 :in_string_don := null;
 set_item_property('S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :list_block.select_flag = 'Y' then
 :control_block.s_donation_type := :list_block.code ;
 :control_block.s_donation_type_desc := :list_block.description ;
 :in_string_don := ''''||:list_block.code||'''';
 exit ;
 end if ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 elsif :global.load_option = 'PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 :in_string_proc := null ;
 set_item_property('S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :list_block.select_flag = 'Y' then
 :control_block.proc_code := :list_block.code ;
 :control_block.s_proc_desc := :list_block.description ;
 :in_string_proc := ''''||:list_block.code||'''';
 exit ;
 end if ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 end if ;
 else
 if :global.load_option = 'DONATION_TYPE' then
 set_item_property('S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 item_change('S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST','E') ;
 set_item_property('S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST',X_POS,50) ;
 set_item_property('S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST',Y_POS,26) ;
 v_list_name := 'S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST' ;
 elsif :global.load_option = 'PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 set_item_property('S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 item_change('S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST','E') ;
 set_item_property('S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST',X_POS,312) ;
 set_item_property('S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST',Y_POS,26) ;
 v_list_name := 'S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST' ;
 end if ;
 clear_list(v_list_name);
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :list_block.select_flag = 'Y' then
 add_list_element(v_list_name,list_counter,:list_block.description,:list_block.code);
 if nvl(length(in_string),0) = 0 then
 in_string := ''''||:list_block.code||'''';
 else
 in_string := in_string||','||''''||:list_block.code||'''';
 end if ;
 list_counter := list_counter + 1 ;
 end if ;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit ;
 else
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 add_list_element(v_list_name,list_counter,'Multiple Selection','MS');
 if :global.load_option = 'DONATION_TYPE' then
 :s_donation_type_list := 'MS' ;
 :in_string_don := in_string ;
 elsif :global.load_option = 'PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 :s_procedure_code_list := 'MS' ;
 :in_string_proc := in_string ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 hide_view('LIST_CANVAS');
 go_block('CONTROL_BLOCK');
end ;

declare
 cursor c1 is
 select donation_type,procedure_code,sum(goal_count) goal_count
 from goals
 where goal_type = decode(:s_option,'A','INGOL','F','FXGOL','M','FLGOL')
 and goal_start_date = :date_block.coll_date
 and goal_end_date = :date_block.coll_date 
 group by donation_type,procedure_code;

begin
 :global.src_item := :system.cursor_item ;

 :s_goal_date := :date_block.coll_date ;
 if :s_option = 'A' then
 :s_goal_custodian := 'Institution Goal' ;
 elsif :s_option = 'F' then
 :s_goal_custodian := 'Fixed Goal' ;
 elsif :s_option = 'M' then
 :s_goal_custodian := 'Field Goal' ;
 end if ;

 show_view('GOAL_CANVAS') ;
 go_block('GOALS_BLOCK') ;
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE) ;
 first_record ;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 :goals_block.donation_type := c1rec.donation_type ;
 :goals_block.procedure_code := c1rec.procedure_code ;
 :goals_block.goal_count := c1rec.goal_count ;
 begin
 select description into :goals_block.dontype_desc
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = c1rec.donation_type ;

 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select description into :goals_block.proc_code_desc
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = c1rec.procedure_code ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 next_record ;
 delete_record ;
 end loop ;
end ;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 rg_name varchar2(40) := 'TEMPDATA' ;
 errcode number ;
 query_string varchar2(1000) ;
BEGIN 
 if :system.block_status = 'QUERY' then
 return ;
 end if ;
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);--pitss synchronize;
 clear_message;
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF not Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 delete_group(rg_name) ;
 END IF;
 query_string :=
 ' select coll_date,sum(decode(unit_id,null,0,1)) actual_draw,'||
 ' sum(decode(unit_id,null,1,0)) actual_deferral from donations '||
 ' where coll_date between :control_block.s_from_date and :control_block.s_to_date '||
 ' and exists (select '''|| 'x'''||
 ' from drives where drives.drive_id=donations.drive_id '||
 'and drive_type = '||
 ' decode(:s_option,'''||'A'''||',drive_type,'''||'F'''||','''||'F'''||','''||'M'''||','||'decode(drive_type,'''||'I'''||','''||'I'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'Unselected'''||')))' ;
 if :in_string_don is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and donation_type in '||'('||:in_string_don||')' ;
 end if ;
 if :in_string_proc is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and procedure_code in '||'('||:in_string_proc||')' ;
 end if ;
 query_string := query_string||' group by coll_date ' ;

 :qry := query_string ;

 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, query_string) ;
 
 errcode := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 

 if get_group_row_count(rg_id) = 0 then
 show_error('9188') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 first_record ;
 for i in 1..get_group_row_count(rg_id) loop
 :date_block.coll_date := get_group_date_cell(rg_name||'.coll_date',i) ;
 :coll_day := to_char(:date_block.coll_date,'DY');
 :date_block.actual_draw := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.actual_draw',i) ;
 :date_block.actual_deferral := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.actual_deferral',i) ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 first_record ;
 end if ;

 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_OPTION','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FROM_DATE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_TO_DATE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_DONATION_TYPE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.PROC_CODE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_DONATION_TYPE_LIST','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST','D') ;
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.PB_RETRIEVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.PB_DON_TYPE_LIST',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.PB_PROCEDURE_CODE_LIST',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;

 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.PB_UNITS',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.PB_GOAL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 rg_name varchar2(40) := 'DONPROCDATA' ;
 errcode number ;
 query_string varchar2(1000) ;
BEGIN 
 if :date_block.coll_date is null then
 return ;
 end if ;

/* Following conditional clearing of blocks is commented because,
 in event of some records in block, data for one coll date gets mixed
 up with other navigated item. 
 By : Dinesh Dtd : 07-15-98
*/
 
-- if :date_block.actual_draw = 0 then 
 go_block('DONPROC_BLOCK') ;
 clear_block ;
 go_block('VENI_BLOCK') ;
 clear_block ;
 go_block('DATE_BLOCK');
-- end if ;

 /*-- Populate DONPROC block --*/
 go_block('DONPROC_BLOCK') ;
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF not Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 delete_group(rg_name) ;
 END IF;
 query_string :=
 ' select donation_type,procedure_code,count(*) actual_draw from donations '||
 ' where coll_date = :date_block.coll_date and unit_id is not null '||
 ' and exists (select '''|| 'x'''||
 ' from drives where drives.drive_id=donations.drive_id '||
 'and drive_type = '||
 ' decode(:s_option,'''||'A'''||',drive_type,'''||'F'''||','''||'F'''||','''||'M'''||','||'decode(drive_type,'''||'I'''||','''||'I'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'Unselected'''||')))' ;
 if :in_string_don is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and donation_type in '||'('||:in_string_don||')' ;
 end if ;
 if :in_string_proc is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and procedure_code in '||'('||:in_string_proc||')' ;
 end if ;
 query_string := query_string||' group by donation_type,procedure_code ' ;

 -- :qry := query_string ;

 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, query_string) ;
 
 errcode := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 

 first_record ;
 for i in 1..get_group_row_count(rg_id) loop
 :donproc_block.donation_type := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.donation_type',i) ;
 :donproc_block.procedure_code := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.procedure_code',i) ;
 :donproc_block.donproc_count := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.actual_draw',i) ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 first_record ;

 /*-- Populate VENI block --*/

 go_block('VENI_BLOCK') ;
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF not Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 delete_group(rg_name) ;
 END IF;

 query_string := null ;
 query_string :=
 ' select attrib_value,count(*) veni_count from donations,donation_attributes donattr '||
 ' where coll_date = :date_block.coll_date and donattr.transaction_id=donations.transaction_id and attrib_code='''||'VENI'''||
 ' and exists (select '''|| 'x'''||
 ' from drives where drives.drive_id=donations.drive_id '||
 'and drive_type = '||
 ' decode(:s_option,'''||'A'''||',drive_type,'''||'F'''||','''||'F'''||','''||'M'''||','||'decode(drive_type,'''||'I'''||','''||'I'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'Unselected'''||')))' ;
 if :in_string_don is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and donation_type in '||'('||:in_string_don||')' ;
 end if ;
 if :in_string_proc is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and procedure_code in '||'('||:in_string_proc||')' ;
 end if ;
 query_string := query_string||' group by attrib_value ' ;

-- :qry := query_string ;

 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, query_string) ;
 
 errcode := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 

 first_record ;
 for i in 1..get_group_row_count(rg_id) loop
 :veni_block.veni_code := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.attrib_value',i) ;
 begin
 select attrib_desc into :veni_block.veni_desc
 from valid_attributes_DON
 where attrib_group = 'VENI' 
 and attrib_table = 'DONATION_ATTRIBUTES' 
 and attrib_code = :veni_block.veni_code ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 :veni_block.dp_count := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.veni_count',i) ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 first_record ;

 /*-- Populate Deferral block --*/

 go_block('DEF_BLOCK') ;
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF not Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 delete_group(rg_name) ;
 END IF;

 query_string := null ;
 query_string :=
 ' select inter_code,originated_from,count(*) def_count from donations,donor_interdictions donint '||
 ' where donations.coll_date = :date_block.coll_date and donint.transaction_id=donations.transaction_id and inter_code in ('''||'PHYTD'''||','''||'PHYPD'''||','''||'HDI'''||','''||'HDT'''||')'||
 ' and exists (select '''|| 'x'''||
 ' from drives where drives.drive_id=donations.drive_id '||
 'and drive_type = '||
 ' decode(:s_option,'''||'A'''||',drive_type,'''||'F'''||','''||'F'''||','''||'M'''||','||'decode(drive_type,'''||'I'''||','''||'I'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'C'''||','''||'Unselected'''||')))' ;
 if :in_string_don is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and donation_type in '||'('||:in_string_don||')' ;
 end if ;
 if :in_string_proc is not null then
 query_string := query_string || ' and procedure_code in '||'('||:in_string_proc||')' ;
 end if ;
 query_string := query_string||' group by inter_code,originated_from ' ;

 :qry := query_string ;

 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, query_string) ;
 
 errcode := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 

 first_record ;
 for i in 1..get_group_row_count(rg_id) loop
 :def_block.inter_code := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.inter_code',i) ;
 :def_block.originated_from := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.originated_from',i) ;

 begin
 select description into :def_block.description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'PHYCD' and
 code = :def_block.originated_from ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 :def_block.def_count := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.def_count',i) ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 first_record ;


 go_block('DATE_BLOCK'); 
END;

PROCEDURE load_options IS
 cursor dontyp is
 select donation_type,description
 from valid_donation_types
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 order by sort_sequence ;
 cursor proccode is
 select procedure_code,description from valid_proc_codes
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 order by sort_sequence ;
BEGIN
 if :control_block.s_from_date is null then
 go_item('control_block.s_from_date');
 show_error('0080') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if :control_block.s_to_date is null then
 go_item('control_block.s_to_date');
 show_error('0080') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if :global.load_option = 'DONATION_TYPE' then
 set_view_property('LIST_CANVAS',VIEWPORT_X_POS,20) ;
 elsif :global.load_option = 'PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 set_view_property('LIST_CANVAS',VIEWPORT_X_POS,280) ;
 end if ;

 go_block('LIST_BLOCK') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE) ;
 first_record ;
 if :global.load_option = 'DONATION_TYPE' then
 for donrec in dontyp loop
 :list_block.code := donrec.donation_type ;
 :list_block.description := donrec.description ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 elsif :global.load_option = 'PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 for procrec in proccode loop
 :list_block.code := procrec.procedure_code ;
 :list_block.description := procrec.description ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 end if ;
 first_record ;
END;

DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
